definitions.explanation: A single person as opposed to a group or organization.
Relating to one person rather than to a group.

notes:
{個人|こじん} means individual or personal.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {個人|こじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as an individual)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{的|てき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (personally)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{差|さ}→個人差：11654_kojinsa⟧ (individual differences)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧ (personal information)
- {個人|こじん}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (sole proprietorship)
- {個人|こじん}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (individualism)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{事業|じぎょう}{主|ぬし}→個人事業主：26304_kojinjigyounushi⟧ (sole proprietor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個人|こじん} (individual) ↔ ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧ (corporation)
- {個人|こじん} (individual) ↔ ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ (group, organization)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{的|てき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧ (personal) ↔ ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧ (public, official)
